== Objectives ==
Thin out the chain of command within Stormwrought Ruins and return to Nippsy Spickerspan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor.
* [[Oronok Torn-Heart]] slain
* [[Chieftain Stormsong]] slain
* [[Stormreaver Battlemaster]] slain (12)

== Description ==
So the time to infiltrate Stormwrought Castle has finally come. This den of devils will demand every last bit of your focus and skill for you to come back in one piece. I won’t mince my words, but you’re surely aware of it yourself already, no? The others and I will secure the perimeter on the castle courtyard to prevent reinforcements halting your operations.

Operative Gillian has ordered you to dispatch the head of the hydra, which is undoubtedly the most crucial task of all. Still, to ensure no resurgence occurs by surviving figureheads, we need to make sure to snuff them out as well. Liquidate any tough guy you come across. We don’t want to deal with that scum again.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* 3100 XP

== Progress ==
I am sure you will run into more than enough fitting candidates for my task there.

== Completion ==
Most impressive. It’s a shame you're not cut out for this field of work. Don’t get me wrong, you possess the skills and wits necessary, but I know your adventurous spirit cannot be tamed and seeks the grandeur of Azeroth. Still, the SI:7 owes you much, so let me reward you appropriately for all you’ve done.
